$comment: Template for character database with pose library system. Equipment as simple array; poses reference reusable library templates.

metadata.title: Character Prompt Template
metadata.description: Template for pose library system - standardized structure validated against character_schema.json
metadata.architecture: Pose library system with equipment as simple arrays, validated structure

thematic_rules.description: Theme-specific rules applied to all prompts
thematic_rules.prompt_snippet: heroic fantasy character, dramatic lighting, strong silhouette

characters.name: example_warrior
characters.visual_notes: Tall, armored, carrying sword and shield, battle-worn. Strong angular face with determined expression.
characters.proportions: Heroic athletic build, broad shoulders, strong limbs
characters.character_base: Heroic warrior in weathered plate armor, battle-scarred but dignified. Face determined with slight scowl. Belt with pouches and rope. Strong contrast for armor plates, belt gear.
equipment: longsword (straight blade, wrapped leather grip, simple cross-guard) : main_hand : held at ready
round shield (wood planks, steel rim, central boss) : off_hand : held at guard
dagger (simple blade, leather sheath) : holstered_belt : sheathed

poses.name: static_heroic
poses.character_override: calm determined expression; armor plates clearly visible; strong grounded presence

poses.name: combat_ready
poses.character_override: alert defensive posture; shield raised; sword ready; battle-ready expression

poses.name: action_pose
poses.character_override: dynamic forward momentum; armor flowing; both legs clearly visible and separated

poses.name: victory_stance
poses.character_override: triumphant expression; weight shifted back; sword raised in victory; strong negative space

poses.name: unarmed_ready
poses.description: Fighter ready stance with weapons set aside
equipment_override: longsword (straight blade, wrapped leather grip, simple cross-guard) : holstered_back : slung on back
round shield (wood planks, steel rim, central boss) : holstered_back : slung on back
dagger (simple blade, leather sheath) : holstered_belt : sheathed
poses.character_override: combat ready stance with hands empty; weapons visible but not held; prepared for unarmed combat

characters.name: example_archer
characters.visual_notes: Light armor, longbow, quiver of arrows. Weathered face with keen eyes and focused expression.
characters.proportions: Lean athletic build, fit ranger physique
characters.character_base: Forest ranger in light leather armor, practical woodland gear. Face alert and focused. Belt with pouches and hunting knife. Quiver of arrows on back.
equipment: longbow (tall curved wood, wrapped grip) : main_hand : held vertically
hunting knife (simple blade, leather wrap) : holstered_belt : sheathed
quiver (leather quiver with arrows) : holstered_back : slung on back

poses.name: static_heroic
poses.character_override: calm alert expression; bow held vertically; ranger stance

poses.name: combat_ready
poses.character_override: focused expression; bow at ready; quiver visible on back

characters.name: example_townsperson
characters.visual_notes: Simple clothes, practical appearance. Friendly open face with warm smile.
characters.character_base: Town resident in simple shirt and trousers; practical boots; approachable demeanor.

pose.name: idle_stand
pose.character_override: relaxed friendly expression; natural everyday posture

pose_library_system.description: Poses are defined in rules/pose_library.json as reusable templates with placeholders
pose_library_system.equipment_format: Equipment defined as simple array of strings with format: 'item (details) : position : usage'
pose_library_system.composition: At generation time, equipment is parsed and injected into pose placeholders (MAIN_HAND_PROP, OFF_HAND_PROP)
pose_library_system.validation: System checks pose handedness_mode matches equipment assignments

structure_requirements.character_id: Sequential integers starting at 1, no gaps or duplicates
structure_requirements.character_base: Main character description - the base visual prompt
structure_requirements.equipment: Array of strings in format: 'item (details) : position : usage'
structure_requirements.tags: Object with gender, age, trope fields (recommended over character-level gender field)
structure_requirements.poses_or_pose: Use 'pose' object for single-pose, 'poses' array for multiple poses

pose_patterns.single_pose: Use 'pose' object for characters with one pose (e.g., ambient NPCs)
pose_patterns.multi_pose: Use 'poses' array for characters with multiple poses (e.g., combat characters)
pose_patterns.library_reference: Use 'pose_library_ref' to reference shared pose templates
pose_patterns.inline_prompt: Use 'prompt' for unique poses not in library (legacy, less preferred)
